scope: Portable tools and Python build environment only. No project engine has been frozen.

target.cpu_baseline: Apple M1; wacli GOARM64=v8.0; C/C++ -mcpu=apple-m1; whisper armv8.4-a+nosve+noi8mm+nosme

python.relocation_note: The runtime relocates. Recreate a venv after moving it; venv absolute paths are not a portable distribution contract. Verified this with an offline venv beside the relocated runtime.

whisper_build.ggml_source: Vendored in the verified whisper.cpp v1.9.5 tree
whisper_build.metal_embedding: 35 Metal kernel source libraries embedded in __DATA,__ggml_metallib; runtime compilation; no external backend plugins or shader files required

openssl-3.5._comment: Remember to update OPENSSL_VERSION_INFO in pythonbuild/disttests/ whenever upgrading.

sqlite._comment: Remember to update pythonbuild/disttests/ when version changed.

xz._comment: IMPORTANT: xz 5.6.0 was released with a backdoor (CVE-2024-3094). This has been resolved. Be cautious before taking any xz upgrades given this past behavior. liblzma is licensed as 0BSD. Other parts of code have different licenses. But we only use liblzma.

verification.tool_dependencies: Apple system libraries only; no tool LC_RPATH; no Homebrew strings in staged tool binaries
verification.python_dependencies: Apple system libraries and bundled relative Tcl/Tk dependencies only; no Homebrew load commands

public_helper_rebuild.note: Start with the generic build directory absent. Source extraction checks pinned archive SHA-256. HOME is never reassigned. Builds stage first, then privacy, architecture, dependency, capability, six-format and CPU/Metal checks must pass before promotion.

limitations: Runtime tests ran on an M1 Max with macOS 27.2. macOS 15 compatibility is supported by load-command audits, deployment settings, and baseline CPU flags; execution on an actual macOS 15 installation remains untested.

privacy_rebuild.binary_privacy_scan: Zero /Users/<name>, /home/<name>, private workspace, or repository-author email matches in all three helpers and FFmpeg configuration output.
